# Psalm 138 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 138:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Of-David. I-will-give-thanks-to-you with-all my-heart; before gods I-will-sing-praises-to-you.
- **LOGOS:** Of David. I give you thanks, O LORD, with my whole heart; before the gods I sing your praise;
- **PNEUMA:** By David. I will thank you, LORD, with everything I have! I will sing your praises in the presence of every other so-called god.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 138:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** In-day I-called and-you-answered-me; you-strengthened-me in-my-soul with-strength.
- **LOGOS:** On the day I called, you answered me; my strength of soul you increased.
- **PNEUMA:** The day I called out, you answered me — you filled me with inner strength.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 138:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Will-give-thanks-to-you O-YHWH all kings-of the-earth, for they-have-heard the-sayings-of your-mouth.
- **LOGOS:** All the kings of the earth shall give you thanks, O LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth,
- **PNEUMA:** Every king on earth will thank you, LORD, when they hear the promises you've spoken.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 138:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-they-will-sing in-ways-of YHWH, for great the-glory-of YHWH.
- **LOGOS:** and they shall sing of the ways of the LORD, for great is the glory of the LORD.
- **PNEUMA:** They will sing about the LORD's ways, because the LORD's glory is immense.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 138:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH will-complete for-me; O-YHWH your-steadfast-love to-forever; works-of your-hands do-not forsake.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O LORD, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your hands.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD will finish what he started in my life. LORD, your faithful love lasts forever — don't abandon what your hands have made!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 138:7 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** If I-walk in-midst-of distress you-will-revive-me; against anger-of my-enemies you-will-stretch-out your-hand, and-will-save-me your-right-hand.
- **LOGOS:** Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and your right hand delivers me.
- **PNEUMA:** Even when I walk through the worst trouble, you keep me alive. You reach out against my enemies' fury, and your right hand rescues me.
